mood: Romantic and wistful: a dusk-lit story you write together in verse, with petals on the wind.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid rose (#FF8FB8) at 50% with a soft glow
shape.texture: subtle paper grain and drifting petals

buttonStyle: Primary is a rose-pink pill with dark plum text in Cormorant semibold and a soft glow on hover; secondary is a translucent plum pill with a cream hairline.
backdrop: Dusk gradient from deep violet to amber with a pale moon and a few petals drifting down slowly (CSS transform), plus a line of verse that fades in and out under 0.5 Hz.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
